mapper.select: SELECT r.category_cd, r.keep_days, r.upd_user, r.upd_dt FROM tb_retention r ORDER BY r.category_cd
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_retention SET keep_days = #{keepDays}, upd_user = #{updUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE category_cd = #{categoryCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_retention (category_cd, keep_days, upd_user, upd_dt) VALUES (#{categoryCd}, #{keepDays}, #{updUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
